language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.
language.lessonRating: How do you feel about this exercise?

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.

Hello, my name is Matt. Welcome to Hanga Roa town, Easter Island. My grandpa and his dog Bobby are living here. I live with my parents in Santiago. But I always come to Hanga Roa to visit my grandpa during my school break
Today, Bobby and I will introduce Hanga Roa to you. Hanga Roa is the only town on Easter Island. This is a very beautiful place. I am sure that you will love it.

First, let’s go to the park, where you will see lots of animals and plants. My grandpa told me that just like people, animals and plants also need a home to survive. This is called a habitat. A habitat is the area that provides food, water, shelter and space for plants and animals to grow and live.
Now Bobby, show us the park!
Hey Matt, don’t forget to show your friends the harbour. They will love it!

My grandpa told me that all living plants and animals in a habitat are interdependent. That means they depend on each other for food. This creates a food chain. A food chain shows which animals eat other animals or plants. Can you put the animals and plants in the right order of the food chain?
